tool.name: transfer_to_owner_en
tool.description: Transfer: tries to connect this call to the owner's phone. Use it only as When to hand off says, with reason person or urgent, at most once per call.

messages.text: One moment while I try to reach them.

config.introduction_prompt: In English, tell the person answering who is calling (the name the caller gave), what it is about, and whether it is urgent, in at most 20 words. Say only what the caller said: no phone number, address or payment detail.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: person when the caller asked to speak to the owner or a person; urgent when the matter needs a person right away. Exactly one of these two words.
